correctness.rationale: The proof supplies the iff linear criterion for all \(a,b\ge0\) and \(c\ge1\), with exact nonempty proper border witnesses for all failures, and uses all 01/10 cyclic starts. The sign-transition trichotomy is exhaustive. Burnside counting treats periodic equal gaps exactly. Direct rational-slope calculations reproduce the classification for all necklaces with 0..28 zeros, 500 larger trials, and class distribution through 149 zeros; independently checking explicit witness lengths for 28,830 triples found no discrepancy. All-length statements are derived mathematically, not by extrapolating these tests.

value.rationale: The theorem resolves a natural precise question left open by the nonreversibility of the known strict-chord lemma in a sparse but infinite and compositionally complete family. It yields an all-rotation structural characterization, exactly identifies the mean-gap arithmetic-progression anomaly, and obtains exact directed-necklace multiplicities at all lengths. This is not the already known literal-unbordered rotation count; two cases with the same prior invariant have different new values. The sharp zero/one/two behavior and typical two-rotation law are motivated pattern-recognition and combinatorial-word information, not an arbitrary small numerical cutoff.
